revenueSources.description: Portion paid directly by Wayne Township residential and commercial property owners (58.4% of your tax bill)
State of New Jersey formula aid covering special education, transit, and security
Audited prior-year fund balance, tuition, and IDEA federal grants

majorAppropriations.details: Classroom teacher compensation, textbook adoptions, and curriculum materials across all 14 district schools.
Medical, prescription, and dental coverage under SEHBP/NJEHP (Chapter 44), employer Social Security/FICA, and workers' compensation.
In-district specialized education teachers, paraprofessional aides, speech therapy, and child study teams.
Heating, electricity, custodial staff, and school security across 14 facilities.
Mandated tuition for specialized external placements and Passaic County Vocational-Technical schools.
Contracted bus routes and special education vehicle transit.
Superintendent, Business Administrator, building principals, and curriculum supervisors.
